name: valve_raven_big_room
note: Ravenholm's big headcrab cave from d1_town_04, lifted whole with --keep-nodraw (its own nodraw shell kept, so it stays shut where it is not cut): a floor about 1600 by 1500 (z -5120), the metal stairs up the shaft (x 430..800, y -1600..-1180) to the brick and plaster landing at its top (floor -3647; its doorway on to the town, x 888..896 y -1280..-1232, is walled up when placed), the timber, Valve's lamps. Box x -1024..1536, y -1792..0, z -5376..-3136, without --centroid: Ravenholm's rock is laid on 256 squares, so cut on that grid it ends exactly at the box. Anchor 1536 -640 -5120: the mouth passage's cut on its east face, on its floor (the passage is clear from y -760 to -536, floor -5120, roof over -4890). Faces east. Its south lobe is cut at y -1792, where its floor is open from x -200 to 900. Left out when placed: Valve's boards (func_physbox), the fence across the mouth passage (fence03a), explosive drums, the makers, items, triggers. Used by CaveForest.big_room.
